body: claimed: Codex (len) · 2026-11-25T09:14Z · branch mkinney:issue/3928-offset-outside-ramp · plan: reproduce the pair (Outside, arc turns off) on a fixture, pin the first moves, then make the entry independent of the corner option

The case does not reproduce on upstream/main `d80dc6944`. No code is changed. The claim is released.

Looks changed by PR #3899 (merged 2026-11-25 04:18 UTC, after this issue was filed). Suggest closing, or add the case that is missing below. The maintainer decides.

## What was run

Each case ran two times: "Arc turns at corners" OFF and ON. The two results were compared: the count of plunges, ramps and helix moves, and each `entry:`, `link:` and `Pass start` note.

- fig8.step, EM-0800-4FL, Outside containment, "Pass starts at" Outside, the heights of `offset_pass_start.rs` (`fig8_world`). Entries: Arc, Ramp, Helix. Release build.
- The band of `pass_start_engagement.rs` (100 x 40 stock, tool D8, stepover 4, three levels), with the stock known. Parts: round, square, plus shape. Entries: Arc, Ramp, Helix, Plunge. Ramp angle 0 and 3 deg. Level transition: none and Ramp. Links: Retract and KeepDown. 96 pairs.

Result on `d80dc6944`: OFF and ON give the same entries in each pair.

fig8, Arc, OFF and ON, the same six descents:

- Three plunges in air at (55.429, -47.000), 14.38 mm off the stock box, one for each level. A G17 arc follows each.
- Three plunges on the floor already cut at (-8.887, -36.945), for the pass start (-7.926, -33.062). Each has its note.

fig8, Ramp (no ramp angle), OFF and ON, the same: `entry: the ramp's chord is blocked - axial dive on the floor instead at (46.929, -38.400)` on each level, with the `EntryStandIn` marker note.

## The answers to "What to check"

- The corner arcs do not change the side plan, the ring count or the ring geometry. `pocket_over_with_relief` plans the passes first. `emit_pocket_passes` rounds only the walks (`round_walks`), after the plan.
- The entry law of #3746 (`air_entry`), the advice of #3748 (`pass_start::entry_advice`) and the edit and create door of #3843 / #3863 (`with_start_side_entry`) do not read `blend_turns`.
- One path reads the result of the corner option: the re-entry at a pass start in material (`descent_dive::entry_restart`). It keeps a ramp only if `moves_clear` finds no crossing with the moves already posted. The posted moves have the corner arcs. Thus the corner option can decide if that ramp is kept.

## Why #3899 is the probable cause of the change

Tree `d94b9816d` (the parent of the #3899 merge), fig8, Outside, Arc: the re-entry at (-7.926, -33.062) is a ramp. Levels Z 12 and Z 2 use the vertical arc ramp (`entry: oblique vertical arc posted as chords`). Level Z 1.5 has the note `the entry would cross prior cuts - ramp along the pass instead`. That is the `moves_clear` path above.

On `d80dc6944`, #3899 (`outside_arc_restart`) replaces that ramp for a selected Arc on an Outside pass. The re-entry is in air, on the floor already cut, or the operation is refused by name. No ramp is made, with the corner option ON or OFF.

I could not show the difference between OFF and ON on the old tree either: on fig8 the two gave the same ramps. The exact case of the report is thus not confirmed.

## What is not covered

- A selected Ramp or Helix on an Outside pass still uses `entry_restart`. There the corner option can still change a re-entry through `moves_clear`. Each stand-in is named in a note and in the `EntryStandIn` warning. No fixture here showed a difference.
- No test pins the pair (Outside, arc turns ON) against (Outside, arc turns OFF).
- Still missing: the sketch, the tool, the selected entry and the first moves of the reported case. With these, the case can be run again.

## Other readings, not part of this issue

- fig8, Outside, Arc, arc turns ON: the operation has 24 `Crossing` warnings (for example `moves: [84, 1055]`). With arc turns OFF it has none.
- fig8, Outside, Arc, OFF and ON: `Gouge` warnings at the first move of each level (`at: 3`).
